hero.title: Where virtual worlds get dressed.
hero.body: Phiegg is home for PFT clubs: hosts for your community, nests that grow into worlds and cities, and a feed of shots made for fashion.

pillars.title: Hosts
pillars.body: Your server, token-gated by verified ownership. Roles come from what you hold.

pillars.title: Nests
pillars.body: Click to nest: a channel, a quest, a world for your club, a city inside that world.

pillars.title: Shots
pillars.body: A visual feed of looks and world captures, tagged to the pieces you own.

pillars.title: Clubs
pillars.body: Every pool gets a home: pieces, holders, worlds and its host in one place.

pillars.title: Worlds
pillars.body: Showcase virtual, AR and agentic worlds, and invite people in from any shot.

pillars.title: Phipad
pillars.body: The accelerator. Cash, mentors and a launch slot for clubs that need them.

rows.label: Community space
rows.b: Host with nests that grow into worlds and cities

rows.label: Worlds
rows.b: Worlds and cities live inside the host

rows.label: Events
rows.b: Drops, runways and stages with RSVPs

cta.title: Hatch your club.
cta.body: Go direct or through Phipad. Same platform, same world.
